summary: Regina Foley, 43, of Havertown PA fell 150 feet while descending Mount Royal off-trail; search crews recovered her body Sunday night via a rope lowering
notes: Article updated Aug 16, 2018; fall was 'Sunday' (Aug 12); per authorities she was the third Summit County hiking death that summer
